# Concept index (GENERATED — do not edit)

Regenerate with `python3 scripts/gen_concept_index.py`; drift is
pinned by `make docs-check` and
`tests/meta/test_concept_index_generated.py`.

One row per change concept from [the documentation
map](README.md). The join is DERIVED from that table,
`docs/catalog.json`, and the linked domain/authority documents;
nothing here is hand-maintained. When a change touches an owner
path in a row, the rest of the row is its semantic
neighbourhood: the contracts that pin the wire, the guard tests
that pin each contract, and the focused tests named by the
owning documents. Run the row's tests before and after the
change. If a path or test named here no longer exists, fix the
source document and regenerate — never edit this file.
